1.0.1.changeLog: Updated to remain compatible with the latest Microsoft changes. No functional changes. Resolves the mismatch status.

1.0.2.changeLog: Microsoft added new default properties to Conditional Access policies: conditions.applications.includeAgentActions (empty list) and sessionControls.humanApproval (not configured). Added them to this policy so deployed policies no longer show a mismatch that Fix Drift cannot resolve. Policy behavior is unchanged.
